description: Single hardware source of truth. Every parameter has value, confirmed/unconfirmed status and source. Dimensions in metres, masses in kg, angles in degrees unless specified. World tabletop z=0. Asset paths exist only in the external versioned pack.

tabletop_z_m.source: Design rule: world z=0 is the tabletop top surface (scene.py contract).

bench_height_m.source: Conflicting historical floor-to-top values 0.885 and 0.801 m; measure in lab. Rendered CAD alignment uses bench_asset_top_z_m.

bench_height_alternatives_m.source: Conflict: Aldrin scene.py comment; jenga-rl layout.py.

bench_top_size_xy_m.source: Placeholder bench in scene.py; the real Vention top size is in the Vention CAD (vention.usd) and not measured.

workstation_xy_m.source: WORKSTATION_XY in settings.py: Vention offset relative to the robot at the origin, from Aldrin's source scene.

bench_scale.source: Preserved Vention USD metersPerUnit=0.01; convert centimetre asset coordinates to metre workcell stage.

bench_asset_top_z_m.source: CAD-only datum: bench/bench.usdc SHA256 34f75072eeb8667e0479cb3573b6df546e353b483712db25dfa5af42d04c9a60; default-prim-relative VentionAssembly_393251_v88_0/imported_PANEL_B2F52AEB2A0D_804849_271/Mesh_91 world bound top 80.0594045970318 cm. Not a lab floor-to-top measurement; bench_height_m remains unconfirmed.

panel_path.source: The bench's top panel (render mesh Mesh_91, collision box Mesh_91_collision/box in pack v2), relative to /World/Bench; the same panel bench_asset_top_z_m measures.

color_rgb.source: Kaleb (2026-11-13): the real tabletop is black. Vention sells black 1/4 in HDPE table panels; the pack's render material was a light rubber. Colour not measured.

roughness.source: Placeholder for a matte HDPE sheet; look only, no effect on physics.

static_friction.source: Placeholder for a wooden Jenga block on HDPE, equal to the block material. Measure with a tilt test: raise one end of the panel until a block starts to slide; static friction = tan(angle).

dynamic_friction.source: As above: the angle at which a sliding block keeps sliding at constant speed. MuJoCo (Newton) uses one sliding coefficient per pair; PhysX uses both.

default_static_friction.source: For every collider with no material of its own (arm, gripper links, bench frame): PhysX's default, so such parts behave the same on Newton, where an unbound collider otherwise gets mu 1.0 (isaacsim.physics.newton newton_config.py:99). Not measured.

combine_mode.source: MuJoCo (Newton) combines two geoms' friction by max (newton solvers/mujoco/kernels.py:162); PhysX is set to max on every material so each pair gets the same friction on both engines.

newton_friction.source: Newton reads one coefficient, dynamicFriction (newton import_usd.py:3982); the work cell sets it to the static value on Newton because Jenga depends mostly on when a block starts to slide. Sliding then runs about 0.05 grippier than on PhysX.

ur5e_links.source: Universal Robots ROS 2 description, config/ur5e/physical_parameters.yaml (rolling; sha256 0e58b89069d8d87b24cce0c2c02832d88de0f3229baf42916953ce1c71f0fa2d): link masses and CoMs in the URDF link frames the pack's robot uses; each tensor rotated by the file's inertia rotation into the link frame and decomposed into principal moments and axes. Masses match UR's DH article (UR5e table). Replaces the CB-series UR5 values the pack carried (4.0/3.7/8.393/2.275/1.219/1.219/0.1879).

rg2_links.source: Total 0.78 kg from the OnRobot RG2 datasheet v1.8 (https://onrobot.com/storage/datasheets/rg2/datasheet_rg2_v1.8_en.pdf, "Weight 0.78 [kg]"), split over the links by convex-hull volume of pack v2's collision hulls (uniform density); CoMs and principal moments from the same hulls with small off-diagonal terms dropped. The base CoM (0, 0.0002, 0.0641) agrees with OnRobot's own model (base 0.193 kg + body 0.464 kg, body 47.3 mm up). Whether 0.78 kg includes the Quick Changer tool side is not stated: weigh it.

initial_joint_deg.source: Presentation pose; not a measured lab home pose.

placement.source: Provisional 5 mm candidate base plate on tabletop; measure real plate and base elevation. Yaw 180 degrees about z (Kaleb, 2026-11-13): the shoulder faces the table, as on the real cell; the imported UR base_link faced away from it.

order.source: Kaleb: likely flange -> Bota -> Quick Changer -> RG2. Configurable: any permutation of bota, quick_changer, rg2 with rg2 last. Verify against the real build.

diameter_m.source: Bota Rokubi serial datasheet: diameter 48 mm (Ø48 x 32 mm); the lab's adapter plates are separate and unmeasured.

length_m.source: Bota Rokubi serial datasheet: height 32 mm. The real stack height also includes the lab's custom adapter plates (both Rokubi faces have M3 patterns, not ISO-50), which are not modelled yet: measure them.

mass_kg.source: Bota Rokubi BFT-ROKS-SER-M8 datasheet (serial version): weight 113 g. Excludes the lab's adapter plates.

sensor_origin_along_axis_m.source: Bota's URDF and documentation: the wrench is expressed at the tool-side face, 32.0 mm from the robot-side face, same axes.

rate_hz.source: Simulation physics sampling rate, not a claimed real Bota output rate.

wrench_topic.source: Preserves existing twin topic. Bota driver topic not pinned in Max sources; remap/configure after lab topic inventory.

wrench_type.source: Existing twin publisher; wrench_utils.py in RISL_ur.

measurement.source: Simulation reaction at Bota mount joint; not calibrated hardware output

model.value: OnRobot Quick Changer (robot side + tool side)

standoff_m.source: Aldrin CAD value (robot.py STANDOFF_M); supersedes the URDF's 15.0 mm.

mass_kg.source: OnRobot Quick Changer datasheet v2.0: robot side 0.06 kg + tool side 0.14 kg (0.41 kg was the Dual Quick Changer). Unconfirmed: the RG2's 0.78 kg may already include its tool side, and whether the lab's unit is v2 or v3 is unknown; weigh it.

datasheet_mass_kg.source: OnRobot RG2 datasheet v1.8 (https://onrobot.com/storage/datasheets/rg2/datasheet_rg2_v1.8_en.pdf): "Weight 0.78 [kg]" (v1.4 said 0.65). It does not say whether the Quick Changer tool side is included.

fitted.source: Proposed printed load-cell tips, not confirmed installed hardware; standard RG2 has no built-in fingertip force sensor.

body_size_m.source: Intel D415 datasheet (99 x 20 x 23 mm) as recalled; verify on the datasheet.

color_fov_deg.source: D415 RGB FOV used by Max (camera_model.py) and by the work cell's workspace camera.

resolution.source: Placeholder: RGB and aligned depth at 1280x720. Set to the profile the real pipeline uses.

offset_in_tool0_m.source: Design pose, not a lab measurement. Max's localizer_bridge.py gives (-0.012,-0.038,-0.005), but there the RG2 fingers and body fill the D415 frustum (projecting the pack's RG2, Quick Changer and Bota vertices through the camera). y is moved to -0.09 and the camera tilted (rotation_in_tool0_deg) so no gripper-stack vertex lies inside the colour frustum plus a 3 degree margin; x and z keep Max's values. Re-measure on the real bracket. Max's camera_model.py has z=-0.010; Aldrin hard-codes a D455 at wrist_3 (0.045,-0.05,0.07), a different camera and mount.

rotation_in_tool0_deg.source: Design tilt, not a lab measurement: 8 degrees about the optical X axis tilts the view away from the tool axis (toward the offset side) so the RG2 fingertips stay out of the frustum (3.7 degrees clear of its edge); the tool axis enters the view about 0.4 m ahead of tool0. Max's code uses identity (camera OPTICAL frame, z forward, y down, equals tool0). Extrinsic XYZ degrees. The USD camera looks along -Z, so the builder adds Rx(180) internally.

mount_position.source: Kaleb says it is now mounted UNDER the arm. Neither Max's tool0 offset (y=-38 mm) nor Aldrin's wrist_3 pose is documented as under-arm: the bracket CAD from Max is pending. Re-measure offset and rotation after the move.

bracket_size_m.source: Placeholder: Printed bracket stand-in until Max's CAD arrives.

bracket_mass_kg.source: Placeholder: Guess for a printed bracket.

camera_mass_kg.source: Intel RealSense D400 datasheet (2023): D415 64 g (the 2020 edition says 72 g). Unconfirmed until weighed with its cable strain relief.

ros_namespace.source: Proposed: realsense2_camera with camera_namespace and camera_name both set to this. Max's localizer reads the camera through pyrealsense2, not ROS topics.

quick_release_base.source: To_buy: Selected camera-only detachable kinematic mount; not a load-bearing gantry base. SmallRig is an alternative.

printed_shelf_size_m.source: Placeholder: Printed camera shelf / tilt arm stand-in.

height_m.source: Design height: the beam underside rests on the release plate stacked over the shelf and camera (asset_layout.overhead_release / overhead_shelf mount_pose); overhead rails stay above the 850 mm reach. Not a lab measurement.

block_mass_kg.source: Kaleb (~15 g); the fmb4 USDs author no mass (density default would give 24 g). Weigh a block.

static_friction.source: jenga-rl block material (0.30 static / 0.25 dynamic); calibration pending.

variation_profile.source: Provisional variation preset, not measured calibration. Replace with a measured profile name or null for nominal dimensions and scalar mass/friction.

variation_seed.source: Arbitrary reproducibility seed, not a measured hardware parameter; overwrite freely or override at build time.

variation_profiles.source: All distribution values and bounds are provisional engineering inputs, not measurements. Replace this value object after weighing blocks and measuring friction and dimensions.

bom_csv.source: Repository BOM path relative to the hardware configuration directory; preserve this layout or overwrite for portable custom configs.

mode.source: Kaleb: physics enables gravity; mirror_real disables gravity on the robot chain only.

trajectory_action.source: RISL_ur scripts (controller_name scaled_joint_trajectory_controller). Sim side: not implemented in phase 1 (joint states only).

impratio.source: 2026-11-13 work-cell Newton probe: without impratio 10 the top layer crept 0.4 mm/s.

drives.source: Chosen 2026-11-14 for Newton's MuJoCo-Warp at 500 Hz: armature 0.1 kg m^2 on every arm joint (as MuJoCo Menagerie's UR5e), stiffness so that dt^2 k / armature <= 2 against the explicit-spring limit of at least 4, damping near critical; validated live, see the work cell README.
